title: Golden Bear Lodge
description:
Escape to Golden Bear Lodge, a private retreat on 13 wooded acres near Old Hickory Lake and just minutes from the city of Mt. Juliet. With a wraparound porch, fire pit, playroom, and wooded trails, it’s perfect for families, groups, or events. Relax on porch swings, explore nature, or gather under the stars. Cozy, spacious, and peaceful—your getaway starts here.

30 minutes to Downtown Nashville
20 minutes to BNA
10 minutes to Providence Mall
5 minutes to grocery
3 minutes to lake access
